# Tayyab — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> https://thisistayyab.dev

Tayyab is a full stack web developer with 3+ years of production experience. He specializes in React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, WebSockets, WebRTC, SaaS platforms, and AI automation. He has solved over 1,150+ problems on LeetCode using C++. Tayyab is available for freelance, contract, and full-time remote work building SaaS products, REST APIs, e-commerce systems, and real-time web applications.

## Featured Products & Case Studies

### 1. Relay — Real-Time Text & P2P File Transfer
Privacy-first real-time collaboration web application featuring instant shared notepad sync and direct peer-to-peer file transfer up to 100 MB via WebRTC data channels. Built with React, Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO. Requires zero user accounts and stores zero data or files on servers.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/relay
- Live App: https://relay.thisistayyab.dev/

### 2. AuditBloc — Web Accessibility & Compliance Scanner
Automated website accessibility, GDPR cookie banner, and AI content disclosure scanner. Developed with Next.js 16, Playwright for automated browser testing, axe-core for WCAG accessibility rule validation, and Supabase for authentication and backend reporting.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/auditbloc
- Live Scanner: https://auditbloc.taylancetech.com/

### 3. Tillqorin POS — Commerce OS for Retail
Web-based retail POS, invoicing, and inventory management system built by Tayyab. Includes barcode generation, thermal receipt printing, sales analytics, multi-register support, and double-entry accounting. Backed by React, Vite, Express.js, and Supabase.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/tillqorin
- Live POS App: https://pos.taylancetech.com/

### 4. Taylance CRM — Clients, Leads & Projects Dashboard
Taylance CRM is a full-featured CRM web application built by Tayyab to manage clients, leads, and projects from one dashboard. Built with React, Express.js, and Material UI, with REST APIs and role-based workflows for sales teams.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects
- Live App: https://crm.taylancetech.com/

### 5. YouTube Video Downloader — Private Archival Tool
Fast, high-fidelity YouTube video and audio extraction web application built with Next.js, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg. Private password-locked tool for personal backups with live download progress.
- Portfolio Case Study: https://thisistayyab.dev/projects/youtube-downloader
- Live App: https://downloader.thisistayyab.dev/ (Private)

## Core Skills & Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, Next.js 15/16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Core Web Vitals optimization
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, WebSockets (Socket.IO), WebRTC, Supabase, FastAPI, authentication & webhooks
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase Database, schema design & query tuning
- **Problem Solving & Algorithms**: 1,150+ LeetCode problems solved with C++ (Data Structures, Graph Algorithms, Dynamic Programming)
- **SEO & Performance**: technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, AVIF/WebP image optimization, Lighthouse 90+ builds
- **Tooling & Cloud**: Docker, Playwright, Jest, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, Linux
